THE STORY

The best moments can't be scripted.

MasterVidy was built around one simple belief: the best moments can't always be scripted. We take challenges into real communities, put real people at the centre of them, and capture whatever happens next.

NO ACTORS.
NO FAKE REACTIONS.

Just moments worth remembering.

OUR MISSION

CREATE MOMENTS
PEOPLE REMEMBER.

Entertainment built around real people, real communities and real experiences.

OUR VISION

ZIMBABWE IS
JUST THE BEGINNING.

Build MasterVidy from a Zimbabwean challenge platform into an entertainment brand recognised across Africa.

MV Challenges — Participant Registration, Consent & Release

Consent version 1.0

1. Voluntary Participation. Registering and taking part in any MV Challenges activity is entirely voluntary. You may withdraw your application at any time before filming begins.

2. Eligibility & Information. You confirm that the name, age, date of birth, gender, area and contact details you provide are accurate. MasterVidy may use this information to assess your suitability for an upcoming challenge.

3. Challenge Rules & Safety. If selected, you agree to follow the safety guidance and rules given by the MasterVidy production team on the day of filming, and to raise any concerns about a challenge's safety before taking part.

4. Filming, Photography & Content Release. If selected and filmed, you grant MasterVidy the right to record, edit and publish your likeness, voice and participation across MasterVidy's channels (including YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp) for entertainment purposes, without further compensation unless separately agreed in writing.

5. Prizes. Where a challenge involves a prize, exact terms, value and eligibility will be communicated directly to selected participants ahead of filming. No prize is guaranteed by registering.

6. Personal Information & Contact. Your details are collected to manage this registration and to contact you if your application matches a challenge. MasterVidy will not sell your information to third parties.

7. WhatsApp Communication. If you tick the optional WhatsApp updates box, MasterVidy may message you about future challenges and opportunities. You can opt out at any time by telling the team directly.

8. Age Requirement. This registration is open only to applicants aged 18 or older at the time of applying. MasterVidy may request proof of age before confirming participation.

9. Conduct. You agree to behave respectfully towards the MasterVidy crew, other contestants and the community while participating in any MV Challenges activity.

10. Confirmation. Ticking the required consent box on the registration form confirms you have read, understood and agreed to this notice. Important: registering online does not replace a separate, production-specific participant/appearance release, which selected contestants will be asked to sign in person before filming.
